name: Financial Incentive Projects - Neighborhood Opportunity Fund (NOF) Large

columns.name: PROJECT NAME
columns.description: The name of the business that received the incentive.

columns.name: APPLICANT NAME
columns.description: The individual, company or organization requesting the incentive.

columns.name: ADDRESS NUMBER
columns.description: The address number of the project location.

columns.name: ADDRESS NUMBER (HIGH)
columns.description: The high address number if the address is a range. For projects with a single address this field will be blank.

columns.name: STREET DIRECTION
columns.description: The cardinal direction of the project street address.

columns.name: STREET NAME
columns.description: The name of the street in the project address.

columns.name: STREET TYPE
columns.description: The type of street in the project address.

columns.name: WARD
columns.description: The Aldermanic Ward in which the project is located.

columns.name: COMMUNITY AREA
columns.description: The Community Area, as defined by the City of Chicago, in which the project is located.

columns.name: APPROVAL DATE
columns.description: The date of the legislative action used to approve the project.

columns.name: COMPLETION DATE
columns.description: The date of the Certificate of Completion or other form of confirmation for project completion.

columns.name: PROPERTY TYPE
columns.description: The land use of the subject property.

columns.name: SQUARE FOOTAGE
columns.description: The area of the portion of the property being affected by the project.

columns.name: PROJECT DESCRIPTION
columns.description: A brief textual description of the project.

columns.name: INCENTIVE AMOUNT
columns.description: The dollar amount of the incentive paid to the applicant.

columns.name: TOTAL PROJECT COST
columns.description: The total value of the project, including the incentive received.

columns.name: OTHER PUBLIC FUNDING
columns.description: The total amount of funding the project received from other public subsidies.

columns.name: JOBS CREATED: ASPIRATIONAL
columns.description: The number of full-time equivalent (FTE) jobs created by the project, without requirement of a Redevelopment Agreement. Jobs Created data may be missing due to projects that have not yet completed surveys.

columns.name: JOBS RETAINED: ASPIRATIONAL
columns.description: The number of existing full-time equivalent (FTE) jobs retained by the project, without requirement of a Redevelopment Agreement. Jobs Retained data may be missing due to projects that have not yet completed surveys.

columns.name: MBE REQUIREMENT MET
columns.description: Confirmation of whether or not the project met Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) contract requirements, established in the redevelopment agreement.

columns.name: MBE PARTICIPATION
columns.description: The total dollar amount of project funding paid to certified Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) contractors.

columns.name: WBE REQUIREMENT MET
columns.description: Confirmation of whether or not the project met Women Business Enterprise (WBE) contract requirements, established in the redevelopment agreement.

columns.name: WBE PARTICIPATION
columns.description: The total dollar amount of project funding paid to certified Women Business Enterprise (WBE) contractors.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: The location of the address columns, geocoded to a format that allows for mapping and other geographic analysis.
